title: M2.2 Art polish — sector_02 skyline placement/scale, tile reads, skin WallRight (pending playtest specifics)
description: Follow-up after the M2.2 art pass (TASK-042 parallax skyline + TASK-043 City tileset) landed and the user playtested sector_02. The user said the art still needs fixes but had not yet given the specifics when the session was paused for /clear. KNOWN candidate items to confirm with the user at resume (DO NOT guess — ask for their specifics first): (1) parallax skyline height/scale/position behind the corridor (the 3 Sprite2D layers in scenes/parallax_background.tscn currently use scale 0.2, repeat_size (900,0), y-offsets far -380 / mid -340 / near +40, x-start -200; tune to taste); (2) tile reads on specific surfaces -- the thin 260x24 ledges and the tall boss wall may tile awkwardly with the 64px City cells (assets/tilesets/city, Tile_85 rail-cap + Tile_88 grate); possibly add more tile variants/edges; (3) the far-right boundary WallRight/Vis ColorRect was intentionally left greybox (off-screen-right) -- skin it or confirm leave; (4) optional set-dressing props (Containers/Crates/Railing/Stairs from the same Bundle A pack) to dress the rooms. SAFETY: any geometry/tile change is VISUAL ONLY -- keep all collision + corridor metrics (-288/+328) and the 98px flight-only boss gap byte-identical (the sector_02 corridor-span + real-physics boss-reachability tests must stay green unchanged). Curate any new tiles/props into assets/ (AssetBundles/ stays gitignored); update assets/CREDITS.md; keep .import siblings. AT RESUME: ask the user for the specific art changes they want, then scope precisely.

comments.author: orchestrator
comments.body: RESOLVED (visual fixes only; original skyline-scale/tile-reads/WallRight/props candidates deferred). BUG-1 occlusion: sector_02 + sector_01 'Background' ColorRect pushed z=-10 -> -50 (behind all parallax) and widened to -700/-700/5300/700 as a full-bleed backstop; skyline now visible. BUG-2 camera void: Camera2D limits are now set PER-LEVEL at runtime (NOT baked into the shared player.tscn, which would have regressed encounter/arena/test_level). scripts/levels/sector_02.gd _ready() -> limits 0/-320/4600/360; scripts/levels/sector_01.gd _ready() -> 0/-320/4200/360 (sector_01's right inner face is x=4200, narrower than sector_02's 4600 -- this is exactly why a single shared clamp void-ed one sector). encounter/arena/test_level stay unclamped (pre-task behavior), pinned by 2 new regression tests. New test test/test_sector_02_visual_bounds.gd (10 tests, instance-the-sector camera assertions + backstop-covers-view + no-baked-limits + encounter/arena unclamped). Reviewer PASS (no HIGH); its MEDIUM (shared-clamp regression) resolved via the per-level refactor it recommended. SAFETY held: collision/body/corridor byte-identical, corridor-span + boss-reachability tests pass unchanged. Full GUT 646/646 green; gdlint clean (orchestrator re-ran). Work on branch task-045-visual-backdrop-camera, committed locally, NOT pushed and NOT merged (awaiting human go on push/playtest).

comments.author: orchestrator
comments.body: RESUME — user gave the specifics (Spanish playtest report): (1) 'un fondo negro tapa la ciudad' and (2) 'la cámara se sale de los fondos, se ve todo mal'. Diagnosis (verified by reading scenes): BUG-1 OCCLUSION — sector_02.tscn 'Background' ColorRect has z_index=-10 (near-black 0.05,0.06,0.09), which renders IN FRONT of every parallax city layer (FarSky z=-30, MidStructures z=-25, NearPillars z=-20) so it paints over the skyline. The parallax scene already ships its own fill ColorRect at z=-40, so the sector-level one is redundant. BUG-2 CAMERA — player.tscn Camera2D has NO limit_left/top/right/bottom; since the hero flies from spawn the camera follows freely past the (small, scale-0.2, vertically-non-tiling) parallax sprites and past level bounds, showing void. No script sets camera limits anywhere; no [display] section so viewport is the Godot default 1152x648. Scope refined to these two visual fixes (the original skyline-scale / tile-reads / WallRight / props candidates are deferred to a later polish ticket).
